sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining silently returns nil when any link in the chain is absent, collapsing the entire expression to nothing
sketches.resonance: Reaching for someone through layers of connection, but if any single link is gone, the whole reaching returns nothing — the silence of a broken chain.

sketches.mechanism: An interface with a single method that is never implemented — the class is declared abstract, so it can never be instantiated
sketches.resonance: A promise of togetherness that can be described but never brought into existence.

sketches.mechanism: A query against a knowledge base with no matching facts returns false — the closed-world assumption means what is not stated simply does not exist
sketches.resonance: In a world defined only by what has been declared, the things left unsaid are not unknown — they are false.
